verses.text: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call: My rock, be not thou deaf unto me; Lest, if thou be silent unto me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

segments.text: Unto thee, O Jehovah, will I call:
My rock, be not thou deaf unto me;
Lest, if thou be silent unto me,
I become like them that go down into the pit.

verses.text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee, When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

segments.text: Hear the voice of my supplications, when I cry unto thee,
When I lift up my hands toward thy holy oracle.

verses.text: Draw me not away with the wicked, And with the workers of iniquity; That speak peace with their neighbors, But mischief is in their hearts.

segments.text: Draw me not away with the wicked,
And with the workers of iniquity;
That speak peace with their neighbors,
But mischief is in their hearts.

verses.text: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings: Give them after the operation of their hands; Render to them their desert.

segments.text: Give them according to their work, and according to the wickedness of their doings:
Give them after the operation of their hands;
Render to them their desert.

verses.text: Because they regard not the works of Jehovah, Nor the operation of his hands, He will break them down and not build them up.

segments.text: Because they regard not the works of Jehovah,
Nor the operation of his hands,
He will break them down and not build them up.

verses.text: Blessed be Jehovah, Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

segments.text: Blessed be Jehovah,
Because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

verses.text: Jehovah is my strength and my shield; My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped: Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; And with my song will I praise him.

segments.text: Jehovah is my strength and my shield;
My heart hath trusted in him, and I am helped:
Therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth;
And with my song will I praise him.

verses.text: Jehovah is their strength, And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

segments.text: Jehovah is their strength,
And he is a stronghold of salvation to his anointed.

verses.text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever.

segments.text: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance:
Be their shepherd also, and bear them up for ever.
